== Summary ==
Players Committee slip PDF of updated double-sided virtual cards (Dark Side: Imperial Entanglements, I Want That Map, Shadow Collective and others), released 24 March 2022 so that each double-sided card needs only one underlying card.

* '''Date posted:''' 2022-03-24
* '''Pages:''' 3

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1372856#p1372856 Updated Slips for Double Sided Virtual Cards (that correspond with a single physical card!)], post 1372856, by DesignAdvocate, 2022-03-24. Original attachment name: updatedflipcards.pdf (5,052,396 bytes); forum attachment id 16342. The forum attachment link is behind Cloudflare: it has no Wayback capture, and a Save Page Now request on 22 November 2026 failed.
* '''Posted by:''' DesignAdvocate
